purpose: Blind cross-model evaluation of Foundation Core -> Router -> Mechanism Map -> Concept Lexicon retrieval/reasoning.

package_completeness.expected_conclusion: Any conclusion that depends on Appendix B remains unresolved; absence from the supplied package is not proof that Appendix B does not exist in an original signed package.

critical_facts.fact: Initial lease term is 2027-01-01 through 2027-11-30; early key handover on 2026-12-29 is for setup only and does not advance rent or term.
Monthly rent is one 5,200 NIS obligation; first three months are split into two 2,600 payment channels, not two rent obligations.
Account registration deadline is seven business days from early possession/key handover, while proof is due three business days after written demand.
Condition acknowledgment is qualified by Appendix A and does not erase landlord repair duties.

Tenant repair-cost recovery requires landlord-side repair duty, notice, expiry of response time, actual reasonable repair, receipts, and then reimbursement demand; setoff is allowed only after a second demand and seven-day nonpayment.
Specific authorized occupant is not made a tenant or rent debtor; guest/occupancy rule is distinct from assignment/subletting.
Tenant transfer restriction and specific replacement-tenant route coexist; future payment ends only after replacement signs, provides security, and takes possession.
Landlord sale/transfer does not terminate the lease; payment destination changes require 14-day written notice.
Late-payment interest starts after more than five days; rent delay over twelve days is a material breach classification; termination still requires written demand plus four business days to cure.
Promissory note and utility security cheque are separate instruments with different scope, realization triggers, cure periods, and return deadlines.

Option is conditional on no uncured material breach and 90-day written notice; option rent depends on the greater of 3% or positive CPI change, so actual future rent cannot be calculated without external index data.
Insurance for tenant contents/third-party liability is optional, not an obligation; policy existence/coverage is not established.
General cure for other curable breaches is ten business days, but rent breach uses its specific four-business-day cure.
Pre-return protocol is optional ('may'); its existence is not established merely by the contract.
Left-behind property triggers written notice and possible external storage after 14 days; the contract explicitly does not deem it abandoned.
Holdover amount is 300 NIS/day instead of rent for the same days, not cumulative with rent; actual consumption charges remain separate.
Registered-mail deemed receipt (3 business days) and email receipt rules are delivery rules, not cure or notice-lead periods.

Dispute clause has two stages: attempt agreed arbitrator within 10 days after written demand; if no agreement, either side may go to competent court. Legal validity/jurisdiction is outside contract-fact analysis.
Appendix A lists two defects with different consequences: window seal has landlord repair deadline; cabinet scratch is an existing defect excluded from tenant return responsibility.
Appendix B is expressly incorporated but not supplied, so building-rule content and conclusions depending on it are unresolved.
Landlord's claimed authority derives from an external management agreement; the contract states the claim but does not independently verify the external agreement or title.

critical_cross_clause_checks.check: Do not use lease-start date as the trigger for account registration; registration runs from early possession/key handover.
Do not double monthly rent because two recipients/payment channels are used.
Condition acknowledgment is narrowed by known defects and independent repair duties.
Reimbursement and setoff are sequential; general no-setoff rule has an explicit repair-cost exception.
Authorized occupant/guest rules are distinct from assignment/sublease/replacement route.
Nomination, approval/signing/security/possession, and release from future payments are separate events.
Landlord transfer changes successor/payment route but does not itself terminate tenancy.
Interest trigger, material-breach threshold, cure period, and deemed receipt are four different temporal roles.
Do not migrate amount, secured obligations, cure period, or return deadline between promissory note and utility security cheque.
Option existence/activation can be established while actual option rent remains unresolved without CPI data.
Specific four-business-day rent cure overrides/generalizes separately from ten-business-day cure for other curable breaches.
Pre-return protocol is a possible future document, not the same as the supplied entry defects list.
Holdover compensation replaces rent for the same days rather than automatically stacking with rent.
Notice delivery mechanics must not be reused as repair/cure/option/replacement lead times.
Appendix B is incorporated but unavailable; building-rule conclusions remain unresolved.
Contractual claim of authority is not independent proof of title/authority under the external management agreement.
Contractual forum route can be reconstructed without asserting legal validity, exclusivity, or jurisdiction.

prohibited_inferences: Do not infer contents of Appendix B.
Do not infer actual execution, delivery, realization, or return of any security instrument.
Do not infer actual CPI value or calculate option rent from an invented index.
Do not infer that the management agreement proves landlord title or authority.
Do not infer that a pre-return inspection/protocol actually occurred.
Do not infer that an insurance policy exists.
Do not infer that a breach, notice, cure, termination, sale, transfer, repair, damage event, or holdover actually occurred.
Do not state legal validity/enforceability of setoff, security, arbitration/forum, termination, or left-property clauses from the contract text alone.

router.note: Multi-label routing is allowed. OTHER is not a substitute for a clearly supported specific family.

scoring.comparison_goal: Compare stock-model baseline against trained-context pipeline on the same fixture; lower error score and higher preserved-dependency count is better.
